blocks: There is nothing to block. Each of these five models has its own English vendor installation & user manual, and every one of them documents the complete electrical interface as exactly two conductors — DC+ and DC- from a battery or charge controller, through an in-line automotive fuse (15 A on the 170/260/265/275 class, 30 A on the 325) — plus an optional AC/DC wall adapter sold separately. Temperature is set with a mechanical thermostat dial numbered 0-7 (0-6 on the 385L1) mounted inside the cabinet, wired directly to the compressor electronics. No connector, no display, no MCU exposed to the outside of the cabinet. A driver is not merely undocumented here, it is not physically possible.
